motionType: JiuQuest-authored paired choreography. These are animated 3D assets, not motion capture.

replacementContract.requirement: Future licensed paired mocap may replace a file only when both roots and the cosmetic slots are preserved.
replacementContract.reservedAttachments: ChestPatch and Lapel_L/Lapel_R remain named empty nodes. Their rigid decorative meshes are intentionally absent.
replacementContract.texturedMaterials: Skin uses a _Ref_RRGGBB sRGB suffix for linear-light cosmetic tint. Eyes retain authored textures. Opaque original hair/brows remain selectable. Seven shared embedded images cover skin color and regional roughness, eyes, cotton roughness and original cloth color/fold-normal/hair atlases. Cloth color and fold normals use UV1; roughness and hair use UV0.

anatomySource: MPFB / MakeHuman core CC0 adult human on the stable Quaternius 65-bone rest rig. More natural adult facial proportions, original solid hair/brows, roomier BJJ gis, modeled tension folds and panel-aligned surface relief. Paired choreography is unchanged.

trap_roll_escape.authoring: New paired choreography with analytic limb contacts; not reverse playback of another clip.

double_leg.authoring: Dense sampled level change, bilateral knee contacts through corner drive, deliberate grip release and grounded top-in-guard landing.

triangle_choke.authoring: Grounded opponent, one arm inside and one outside, ankle-to-knee figure-four contact, head control; requires coach review of finish mechanics.

rear_naked_choke.authoring: Grounded seated pelvis, inside foot hooks, same-arm hand fighting, choking hand to biceps and support hand behind head; requires coach review.

standing_stance.authoring: Planted neutral entry shared with double-leg, with a closed full-cycle breathing loop.
